headline: Decline in Diaspora Remittances Squeezes Kenyan Household Budgets
summary: Kenyan households face reduced seasonal spending power following a rare decline in diaspora remittances alongside elevated living costs ahead of the festive season.
why: Diaspora remittances represent Kenya's largest single source of foreign exchange and directly support household consumption.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Lower remittance inflows reduce domestic retail spending and household liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
